== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Lothal (Errata 2)]]: Left: the image of [[Lothal (Errata)]] (published 12 December 2022, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Light/large/lothal.gif holotable 12d0bca]); right: the image of [[Lothal (Errata 2)]] (published 30 December 2024, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Light/large/lothal.gif holotable 9d2c01e]). Same area (x 88–720, y 62–1039) cropped from each published image <code>lothal.gif</code>; pixels unchanged. Made by placing the two unscaled crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
